title: Faction Field Contacts
subtitle: Observe first, commit later
summary: Crashbreak and Radwarden field signals are early contact hooks. They should teach recognition and caution before deeper faction work.
body: A faction marker is not automatically a combat objective. Scan signs, read standing text, and leave if the contact is restricted.
Crashbreak routes are salvage-adjacent. Radwarden perimeter signs are warnings until the player has a reason and standing to approach.
Faction work should remain optional in first-month progression unless a mission clearly states the requirement.
